description: This is a Java interface file defining the data access object (DAO) for ProductOption entities, providing methods for retrieving and managing product options within a merchant store context.

classes.name: ProductOptionDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to ProductOption entities, extending generic DAO functionalities.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product options associated with a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Fetches product options by name for a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing ProductOption entity, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves read-only product options for a given store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Gets a ProductOption by store and option code.
